description.fun: A flamingo that ties its neck in a knot to stop the energy stored in its belly from escaping out of its beak. Flamigo flocks can number over 10,000, and thanks to a behaviour called 'synchronizing', a whole flock can attack at once in perfect harmony. Spain has Europe's biggest flamingo population, and 'amigo' is hidden in its name.
description.guide: A Flying and Fighting-type flamingo Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet that lives in huge flocks and attacks in unison. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A knotted flamingo that fights in perfect sync
